notes.title: Confirmed! The Early Access release date is October 20
notes.content:
[p]Dear Stonkers[/p][p][/p][p]We have a confirmed date for our Early Access release![/p][p]🕒 [b]October 20 at 09:00AM Pacific time [/b]🕒[/p][p][/p][p][u]Confirmed[/u]. [u]Double[/u] confirmed. [u]Triple[/u] Confirmed.[/p][p]Save the date, and please Wishlist the game so you get notified as soon as it is released![/p][p][/p][h2]💰Pricing[/h2][p]Gamestonk Simulator: Gone Rogue will release in Early Access at [b]$10.99[/b], with a [b]15% launch discount[/b] for a limited time to jump in from day one!
Note: Version 1.0 will be slightly pricier.[/p][p align="start"][b]launch price:[/b][/p][p align="start"]💵 USD – $10.99 💵[/p][p]🧮 Launch Discount - 15% 🧮[/p][p][/p][h2]💞A massive Thank You to our Community![/h2][p]You waited... and waited... and waited. We cannot be more grateful for your patience, your support, and your encouragement.[/p][p]The recent phase had some uncertainty to say the least, and that is over. The date is definitive, and all clearances are obtained.[/p][p]We as developers are finally getting rid of the anxiety of waiting for release and entering the excitement phase of polishing the game up to your expectations for the 1.0 Full Release.[/p][p][/p][h2]🔥What to expect during Early Access[/h2][p]We are moving forward with the roadmap announced on the Steam page, with the guidance and feedback of our dear Stonkers and hand in hand with them.[/p][p]You may felt hints that we'd been working on it since the start of the waiting phase, and indeed we have already completed quite a few milestones of the roadmap:[/p][p]📦 Stockers: Done ✅[/p][p]🔨 Bouncers: Done ✅[/p][p]📈 Trade Ins: Internal Testing[/p][p]🎨 New Skins and Wallpapers: Done ✅[/p][p]🏦 Upgradable Bank: Done ✅[/p][p]🦸 NPC diversity: Done ✅[/p][p]🎭 NPC Behavior diversity: In development[/p][p]🏏 Weapons: Internal Testing[/p][p]🧳 NPC Loot: Internal Testing[/p][p]💬 Dialogues: Done ✅[/p][p][/p][h2]🏞 The roadmap is not everything![/h2][p]There is more. The roadmap is a promise, and we are keeping that promise. However, from time to time, there are inputs and feedback from the community that is of much higher value than the roadmap items. Do we drop them? Definitely not, we prioritize them.[/p][p]🔧 Perma Upgrades and Additional 🃏 Mod Packs are such cases.[/p][p]We strongly encourage you all (in fact, we beg you) to keep up the suggestions and feedback so we make the best game we can and meet your expectations.[/p][p]🔊You can do so as posts on Steam's community hub or the corresponding channels on our Discord server.[/p][p][/p][h2]👥What is next for the Community[/h2][p]More of them same! We are reinvigorating our Guild of Experts and as usual observing the channels dedicated to your feedback, both on Steam and Discord 👾.[/p][p]Meanwhile we are preparing some events:[/p][p]🎆 Steam Next Fest event coming up[/p][p]🚀 Launch event coming up[/p][p]Thank you in advance for playing the game, and we are waiting for your guidance![/p][p][/p][p]See you on the other side of Early Access[/p][p]Your GameStonk Simulator: Gone Rogue team[/p]

notes.title: Early Access Launch: Awaiting Steam Approval
notes.content: [p]Hey Stonkers,[/p][p][/p][p]We have an important update to share regarding our Early Access launch, which was originally planned for today.[/p][p]Unfortunately, the game will not be going live as expected due to delays in the Steam review and approval process. While we submitted everything on July 11, well ahead of the recommended 3–5 business days, Steam has informed us that their review is taking longer than usual.[/p][p][/p][p]This situation is completely out of our hands, and we’re just as eager as you are to get the game into your hands. We’ve done everything on our end, and now we’re simply waiting for Steam’s final approval to move forward.[/p][p]At this point, we won’t be announcing a new release date until the game has successfully passed the approval process. We’ll update you the moment we have confirmation.[/p][p][/p][p]Believe us, no one was as eager and anxious to get the game out into Early Access as us. Since we announced our date of July 30, it's been an anxious couple of weeks. Will the Stonkers enjoy the Early Access version? Will they play? Will they give their usual constructive feedback? Will they share it with their friends? Will they stream it? Will we meet their expectations?[/p][p]It has been a burden we couldn't wait to offload today, and now here we are fated to carry it for longer. It could be a few days; it could be a couple of weeks. But carry its anxiety we must.[/p][p][/p][p]We promise we are going to keep working on the game as you have been used to seeing us do since the first demo, and in fact with even more enthusiasm and drive.[/p][p][/p][p]For those of you who holding Steam keys to be redeemed before July 30, received as giveaways in previous events, organized by our wonderful guild of experts members and streamers, or for winning it in the truck drop event in previous demo versions, do NOT worry, we got you covered: You can still redeem your key even after July 30, as long as you do so before the yet to be announced new date.[/p][p][/p][p]We’re incredibly grateful for your patience and support, and we can’t wait to welcome you into the Early Access version as soon as we’re given the green light.[/p][p][/p][p]Thank you for sticking with us. We’ll keep you posted.[/p][p][/p][p]Cordially,[/p][p]Your GameStonk Simulator: Gone Rogue team[/p]

notes.title: On Game Covers
notes.content:
[p][b]"Disclaimer: Some game titles may crack you up!"[/b][/p][p]We didn’t dare add that line to [i]Gamestonk Simulator[/i]’s short description—at least, not until we heard back from you, our beloved Stonkers.[/p][p][/p][p]From the very beginning, the game covers were something we wanted to stand out. They were risky, bold, and very close to our hearts. Revealing them to the early playtesters was nerve-wracking—but we had to do it![/p][p]And your feedback came back clear and loud: you loved them. Or, at the very least, you appreciated the effort we put into them. That gave us a huge confidence boost and helped carry us through the development of [i]Gamestonk Simulator: Gone Rogue[/i]. Your suggestions for names and cover ideas on Discord were an even bigger lift—and still are. Thank you for that.[/p][p][/p][p]One thing we want to emphasize: the game covers are 100% handcrafted. No AI, no stock assets—just pixel-pushing love and hand-drawn nonsense. Because handmade art belongs in a world inspired by the golden age of physical game stores. It’s core to [i]Gamestonk Simulator: Gone Rogue[/i]’s identity.[/p][p][/p][p]Now, this may sound strange—but we’re actually retiring a few of the covers.[/p][p]Why, you ask? Well… precisely [i]because[/i] they’re such a defining part of the game. If we’re going to stand out with our covers, then we owe it to ourselves—and to you—to push even harder. We think we can do better. So we’re replacing a few of them with new ones, and we’re excited to show you what’s next.[/p][p][/p][p]The full reveal of the swapped-out covers and their replacements will go live with Early Access.[/p][p][/p][p]Thank you for being part of the beginning—and for co-producing this wonderfully weird journey with us.[/p][p]Cordially,
[i]The Gamestonk Simulator: Gone Rogue[/i] Team[/p]

notes.title: On Roguelite Mode
notes.content:
[p]Dear Stonkers,[/p][p][/p][p]From the very first day working on [i]GameStonk Simulator[/i], we set out to break the mold of traditional job simulators, while staying true to the core fantasy of running an old-school video game store.[/p][p]For better or worse, the clearest path to innovation led us to something bold: roguelite mode.[/p][p][/p][p]The full story behind this feature’s creation is a tale for another post. For now, we want to focus on why it exists, and how we believe it transforms the player experience, especially for those of you who love job sims but are looking for a twist.[/p][p][/p][p]Permadeath, for one, fits the story. You’re running the last video game store in town, in a world where mom-and-pop shops are fading away under pressure from online retail giants. Every week is survival mode. And for those of us who grew up hanging out in game stores -browsing, chatting, loitering- it only felt right to channel that nostalgia while also honoring the real-world hustle it represents.[/p][p]The weekly score targets create just the right amount of pressure. It’s not punishing, it’s purposeful. You’ll feel the drive to adapt, to optimize, to strategize. You’ll set big-picture goals for your store instead of just checking off to-do lists. That sense of urgency makes each run feel personal.[/p][p][/p][p]One of the most exciting things for us was moving away from fixed upgrade paths. Instead of unlocking features in a linear, pre-scripted way with minor trade-offs, your store evolves through the daily truck rolls. Wish you had more foot traffic? Slower reputation decay? Fewer (or more) thieves? Higher price margins? There are modifiers for all that.. and more. Every run becomes a sandbox for experimentation and player-defined strategy.[/p][p][/p][p]Still, we heard your concerns, loud and clear. The tension of roguelite play sometimes clashed with the joy of constant progression. We’ve addressed this in two key ways.[/p][p][/p][p]First, there’s the endless tycoon mode. No permadeath. No resets. Just your dream store growing forever. It’s all about freedom, and it’s here to stay.[/p][p][/p][p]Second, and more subtly, we introduced the “Retros Are Forever” system. You find a retro, you keep it, even if your store closes down. These items aren’t just trophies; they will influence your future runs profits and may even unlock permanent upgrades. It’s our way of saying: yes, the store might fall, but your legacy carries forward.[/p][p][/p][p]This is how we’re trying to make a dent in the genre. It may work. It may not. But we’re proud to be taking a risk.[/p][p]We’ve got a long road ahead, and Early Access is just the beginning. Thank you for being here at the start.[/p][p][/p][p]Cordially,
GameStonk Simulator: Gone Rogue team[/p]

[p]
Hey last physical videogame store saviours![/p][p]GameStonk Simulator is finally coming to Steam Early Access July 30 at 17:00 UTC / 10:00 PT!
[/p][h2]💰 Pricing[/h2][p]Gamestonk Simulator: Gone Rogue will launch in Early Access at [b]$10.99[/b], with a [b]15% launch discount[/b] for a limited time to jump in from day one!
Note: Version 1.0 will be slightly pricier.[/p][p][b]launch price:[/b]  [/p][p]💵 USD – $10.99[/p][p][/p][h2]❤️ A Huge Thank You to Our Community[/h2][p]We wouldn’t be here without you. Let’s keep building the ultimate shop simulator together!
[/p][h3]🔥 What to Expect in Early Access[/h3][p]🛒 Fully playable core roguelite shop loop  [/p][p]📦 Endless Mode for chill tycoon fans  [/p][p]🎮 Retro collection that persists across runs  [/p][p]🃏 Strategic modifiers each morning  [/p][p]🧍‍♂️ Staff you can hire (cashiers)  [/p][p]🪓 Defend your store from shoplifters with your trusty bat  [/p][p]🗺️ Expanding store upgrades

notes.title: Roadmap Announcement
notes.content:
Stonkers

We've been hard at work on the roadmap internally, but it's been a while we haven't announced any of its update.

As I noticed many of you spent some time going over it during your steams, I thought the least we can do is provide updates as to where we are with it, and what our vision for the announced roadmap is.

Of course, we are not dogmatic about specific features, but are stubborn with our vision. So we'd love to hear from you, and adjust as long as it makes sense and is within our vision.

[i][b]It would be nice if you could give us an indication of priority as I am listing them below just as we had listed them on the main menu of the old demo.
[/b][/i]

✅[b]Unboxing Collectibles that "fell off the truck"...
[/b]Done. To be deepened.
You may have noticed the lore on this one is the mafia goons who sometimes happen to hijack trucks, our beloved truck being an integral part of the game.

We noticed that some of you enjoyed the engagement with this part so we're putting some more efforts in making it deeper and giving you more agency:
- More rarity properties
- More meaningful pricing


✅[b]Online Orders...
[/b]Done. To be updated.
We have our own thoughts on what needs be done with the delivery system. We did spend time watching you play it, and are listening to suggestions.
I do not want to give more details on this at the moment so we keep your suggestions unbiased.


❌[b][b]LAN Gaming...
[/b][/b]To be cancelled.
We decided to remove this system as it will be replaced by the employees system. Sounds weird, right? Hear me out.
The reason we want a LAN Gaming system was to allow customers to walk in, sit on gaming stations that the players has deployed in the store, and leave when done.
It's a great way to have an idle loop where the player has agency to balance between tedious work with the game sales, or more idle strategic experience with LAN Gaming's passive income.
Well, the employees will provide just that idle strategic experience, baked into the regular game sales loop.
LAN Gaming felt therefore redundant, and we're working on the lore and vibe of the store to be more like a video game store as a opposed to a gaming cafe.
We even programmed and modeled what is needed for the LAN Gaming behavior, but will keep it out.


🟠[b]Trade Ins...
[/b]Still on roadmap. Didn't have the chance to give it enough thought yet. We really want to elaborate the retros loop before we bake this system meaningfully into it.

✅[b]Multiplayer...
[/b]
Done. To be polished.
Well that was the aspect that we thought "will catch you off guard" since initially we said we would only do it after a successful EA.
However, the requests for multiplayer were overwhelming, and we thought eff it let's just prioritize it.
Ngl it cost us a lot of time to get it ready on time.

An important point related to multiplayer here was that we didn't just want the store to be a place for hang out, but wanted to include a meaningful gameplay where collaboration, synchronization, and division of labor are important, while at the same time maintaining a clean solo experience.

This is where the deliveries system comes into play. Some of you who tried it may have noticed that it is too cumbersome to play the deliveries solo (though not doing them is not punitive at all), and some straight away went into play the deliveries with friends.


✅[b]Meaningful Store Rating...
[/b]Done. To polish readability and response.
We did multiple iterations on the store rating. Most of the times it had an important impact on the gameplay, but lacked readability where the player was unable to grasp what cause the store rating, and what were the consequences of the store rating.
We believe we found a simple and elegant meaning to it: the rating tabs in the daily reports explains what is affecting it, and it impacts some customers changing their mind and walking away due to the rating.


🟠[b]Goals for your significant other...
[/b]This was an abstract title was a bit misunderstood by some. The idea was to provide some form of longer term goal setting to the player. Your significant other comes to you, fledgling game retail entrepreneur, and encourages you, and depending on your all time high balance every 30 days or so, we give you a 1-, 2-, or 3-trophies rating.
You can tell that this system may clash with the Lose Condition, as it provides more of a long-term tycoon experience, while the Lose Condition should have binary objectives (win / lose).
We have a design for the Lose Condition where you won't make you necessarily repeat the whole game and still be able to build up your empire over time, but we have not decided which system we will go with.
Most likely the Guild of Experts playtests will give a lot of guidance on this.


🟠[b]Chronological release of games by generation...
[/b]Will have to do with the Goal Setting or Lose Condition . So pending.


🟠[b]Lose Condition...
[/b]All I can say now that if you miss too may orders, something bad may eventually happen. But you can have control over how many orders you are allowed to miss until that cataclysm occurs.


🟠[b]NPC and NPC behavior diversity...
[/b]Currently most NPCs have more or less very similar profiles: patience, basket size, chance to be a thief, speed, store browsing duration, health, defense, loot.
They all share physiological features and behave similarly when hit.
We have a chance for a huge diversity there, and a variety of behaviors, disagree?
Staying on roadmap.


🟠[b]Weapons...
[/b]Self explanatory but not too meaningful until we have at least some diversity in NPC behaviors.
Staying on roadmap.


🟠[b]NPC loot...
[/b]To be elaborated.
Most were positively surprised when receiving a large sum from the NPC loot but also when dropping items. To be elaborated.


🟠[b]Shelf skins, counter skins, wallpapers...
[/b]Definitely. But you gotta earn them.


🟠[b]Upgradable bank...
[/b]As you become a tycoon, the loans or deposit sizes may be meaningless to you. You need to be able to upgrade the bank, but earn the upgrades by using the bank, otherwise it creates exploits where in the early and mid-game, you may effectively have infinite money if we unlock large amounts early on.


🟠[b]Dialogues with NPCs...
[/b]For God's sake, stop dancing around the NPCs as they walk by the store!! They still can't react to your buffooneries


🟠[b]Buffoneries...
[/b]As we go


✅[b]Renaming your shop...
[/b]Imminent

Wish you health, blessings, and peace with every update
Use the bat responsibly!

notes.title: Update #1 to the Guild of Experts
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45321263/35d8b47192a35bc655a24fbede8fcac101456867.png[/img]

Hey Stonkers

We initially tried tracking points and ranks as mentioned in the Stonky Rewards Program we explained above, but things got complicated fast. Since many of you were excited about the Rewards Program, we’re keeping its spirit alive—just in a simpler, more streamlined way!

What’s Changing?
No more ranks or point counting.
Instead, our dev team will review community contributions twice a month, focusing on:
Streams, VODs, YouTube videos, TikToks—any content about GameStonk Simulator (quality, length, and engagement matter).
Valuable feedback shared on our Discord.

From there, we’ll select contributors to join our exclusive Guild of Experts Channel, where they'll get:
✅ Access to dev builds to test new features before it's released to the general public and provide direct feedback.
✅ The chance to have your actual voice recorded and included as in-game audio.
✅ And more surprises brewing…

How to Join the Guild of Experts
1️⃣ Create high-quality content about GameStonk Simulator and share it in ⁠📽clips-and-highlights .
2️⃣ Provide helpful and unique feedback in ⁠🪲bugs-n-feedback .

We'll review contributions semi-monthly and invite select members to join.

🚀 Excited to join the Guild of Experts? React to this message to let us know!

And if you have any questions, drop it in the ⁠💬ᴍᴀɪɴ-ᴄʜᴀᴛ and I'll get back to you!

Happy game selling/people smacking!

notes.title: A new version is out!
notes.content:
Thank you all for the massive feedback you've provided over the past couple of weeks, we've been hard at work and we're very excited for you to try this version. As always join our discord and report any bugs or feedback there for quicker communication.

[h2]Additions:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Added rotation and movement effects to the customers loot drops
[*] Added new banknotes art and coins textures
[*] Added resolution and Fullscreen options to settings. Note that I'm forcing resolutions with 16:9 and 16:10 aspect ratios. Ultrawide aspect resolutions (21:9) are causing many UI issues so we opted to exclude their support for now.
[*] Added "Riot" days to the calendar where customers are more likely to steal on those days
[*] Added furniture releases notices to calendar
[*] Added Credits to main menu
[*] Added a roadmap to main menu screen
[*] Added Settings to main menu
[*] Added furniture snapping (hold alt)
[*] Added demo locks
[/list]

[h2]Fixes:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed reroll cost getting stuck and not resetting the following day
[*] Fixed sensitivity and audio settings not saving
[*] Fixed an issue causing box thieves not to detect boxes, you should start encountering them now. Assuming you leave boxes on the ground (not on storage shelves)
[*] Fixed a bunch of typos (please let us know if you find any others)
[*] Fixed compatibility bonus modifier text
[*] Loan and rent bill now take into account when you took out the loan/expanded the store (updated daily, instead of weekly)
[*] Fixed customers stuck after moving the checkout desk
[*] Fixed checkout items stacking weirdly when checkout location is changed
[*] Fixed blue controller UI image
[*] Fixed storage cabinet disappearing after coming back to a save
[*] Fixed being able to place boxes over each other in storage cabinet which resulted in one of the boxes disappearing
[*] Fixed bat disappearing when checkout counter moved over it.
[*] Fixed incorrect item price calculation (some items were being sold at a loss)
[*] Fixed mugging and checkout counter not incrementing correctly
[*] Fixed total value calculation in daily report missed orders, revenue and expenses drop-downs
[*] Fixed box thieves stealing boxes from your hand
[/list]

[h2]Updates:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Replaced placeholder van item models
[*] Updated calendar UI
[*] Updated van UI
[*] Updated cart UI
[*] Removed repeat items from the van (note that on the first day repeat items might still show up if you already bought the license, since the total possible items will be less than 3)
[*] Trash bin will show up on day 1 in the van
[*] Thieves will no longer show up before day 3
[*] Lowered customer SFX utterance rate to %25 and made them less noisy (if they are still too much, please let us know)
[*] Removed currency localization: We believe this was causing the issue of item prices being extremely long. Currencies will now all be evaluated as US dollars
[*] The mouse is no longer confined to the window when the UI is open
[/list]

notes.title: GameStonk Demo Loyalty Program
notes.content:
[h2]We're very excited to announce our Demo Loyalty Program: Earn points to earn perks![/h2]

How Does it work?

1️⃣[b]Earn points[/b] by contributing according to the list below.  
2️⃣[b]Reach specific ranks[/b] by gaining the required amount of points.  
3️⃣[b]Gain perks [/b] when you reach the related rank. :trophy:

-------------------------------------------------

[h3]Points:[/h3]
- [b]Send a screenshot of your in-game store to the Discord server:[/b] +20 points once
- [b]Get selected as an expert inside the demo:[/b] +20 points per selection
- [b]Get a bug submission approved:[/b] +30 points per unique approved bug
- [b]Get a game suggestion voted on:[/b] +50 points per majority-voted suggestion
- [b]Get a loyalty program perk suggestion approved[/b]: +50 points per unique approved suggestion
- [b]Unique views on YouTube:[/b] +5 points per view
- [b]Twitch average concurrent viewers:[/b] +10 points per average viewer
- [b]TikTok likes:[/b] +5 points per like

-------------------------------------------------

[h3]Ranks & Perks:[/h3]

[b]🎖️Store Associate[/b] 20 pts
[b]Perks:[/b] Special Discord role

[b]🎖️Stock Keeper[/b] 100 pts
[b]Perks:[/b] All of Store Associate perks + 
     Early access 

[b]🎖️Store Manager [/b] 5,000 pts
[b]Perks:[/b] All of Store Stock Keeper perks +
     Listed as an official in-game streamer on the homepage (sorted by seniority & popularity)

[b]🎖️Chain Manager [/b] 50,000 pts
[b]Perks:[/b] All of Store Manager perks +
    Access to alpha builds
    Ability to distribute exclusive in-game cosmetic posters

[b]🎖️Franchise Manager[/b] 500,000 pts
[b]Perks:[/b] All of Chain Manager perks +
     Own voice added to the game (limited to 100 participants)
     Name listed in the game credits

[b]🎖️Tycoon Tiers (Multiple Levels)[/b] pts Varies by tier
[b]Perks:[/b] include: All of Franchise Manager perks +
    🔥Coming soon
-------------------------------------------------


[h3]FAQ:[/h3]
 
:question: [b]Q1: How do I join the loyalty program?[/b]
Join our discord 👇to gain access to the Loyalty Program
You’re automatically eligible! Start earning points by completing any of the listed actions. Just make sure to submit proof when required, like screenshots or links, through our designated channels (e.g., Discord).

:question: [b]Q2: How often will you by counting points?[/b]
We'll check and calculate points once weekly on Friday.

:question: [b]Q3: Do points expire?[/b]
No, points you earn are permanent and will accumulate as you participate. Keep engaging to climb the ranks!

:question: [b]Q4: How do I submit proof for points?[/b]
For actions like screenshots, TikTok likes, or Twitch averages, submit proof in the designated Discord channel.

:question: [b]Q5: How do I track my points and rank?[/b]
Your points and rank will be updated regularly on our Discord server. Look out for announcements or check your profile in the loyalty program channel.

:question: [b]Q6: Can I lose my rank?[/b]
No, once you reach a rank, it’s yours to keep. You can only move up, never down!

:question: [b]Q7: What’s included in the Tycoon Tiers perks?[/b]
Details about Tycoon Tier perks are coming soon! Expect exclusive rewards like unique game cover art, custom-designed in-game cosmetics, and VIP privileges.

:question: [b]Q8: What if I have more questions or need help?[/b]
Reach out to our team via Discord! We’re here to help and ensure you enjoy your loyalty program experience.
